summary: Off-registry HTTP URL dependency controls installed code
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `cache-format-syntax-tracer` as the arbitrary URL `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/cache-format-syntax-tracer` rather than a registry version range. The shipped index.js is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the entire installed code surface and any lifecycle scripts come from whatever bytes that endpoint serves at install time. The dependency source is unpinned, has no integrity hash, and resolves to a domain (creditslib.com) unrelated to the @flexmr scope and the package's declared homepage. On `npm install`, the fetched tarball is executed with full lifecycle-script privileges on the installer's host, and the content can change silently between installs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
